source: v2 10-06 bundle (server.mjs sha256 99ddcd10…, with queue-work.mjs) on PostgreSQL, every step through handle(); api/tools/v2-fixtures/gen_kiosk_http.mjs
about: The 10-06 bundle's queue work (queue-work.mjs): list with filter and page for anyone signed in, the claim with its start time, the holder's repeat claim, the two Thai refusals of a claim, notifications with who is working since when, fifty to a page, and a second branch.
reading: A step is one request. `at` is the server clock when it arrived; a step with `view` is a read taken at the clock of the step before it. `body` is the JSON v2 answered; wherever {"$shared":"sN"} stands, put `shared.sN` there (recursively) and serialise without spaces, keys in the order written: those are v2's bytes. `headers` is written only where it differs from `defaultHeaders`. `text` replaces `body` when the answer was not JSON.
